html:
Aachen (euros per month)

Rent: 330

Insurance (private): 80

Phone: 15

Semester ticket: about 200 a semester, so about 35 a month

Internet: 80 a year, about 7 a month

That’s about 470 so far


Food and drink, if you cook everything yourself and shop at the supermarket: a bit over 200 is plenty

Eating and drinking out with friends once a week: 150 is enough


Add extras like clothes and so on,

and you can live pretty well on 1,000 euros.
